headline: Uninorte and Promigas Invest $11.570 Million in University Solar Farm
summary: Uninorte and Promigas invested $11.570 million to build a large university solar farm, making data available for student and faculty research projects.
why: Private-academic energy partnerships promote technological innovation and clean energy development in regional markets.
